description: Compares the current electricity price across every covered European market, sorted cheapest first by all-in price. All figures are EUR per kWh so markets are directly comparable. The snapshot is refreshed at most hourly (see asOfUtc) and uses the current hour's average price. All-in = variable household price per kWh: spot + energy tax + per-kWh grid fee + VAT. Fixed monthly charges (grid capacity, tax credits) are excluded. Spot = wholesale day-ahead price.
name: compare_markets
title: Compare all markets
